h1: Can an ADU be used for Airbnb or short-term rentals in Massachusetts?
title: Massachusetts and Newton ADU Short-Term Rental Rules
description: Learn how state ADU law treats short-term rentals and what Newton currently says about renting an ADU.
short_answer: Massachusetts state law allows municipalities to impose restrictions or prohibitions on short-term rentals of ADUs. Newton says its ADUs cannot be used as short-term rentals and must be rented for a period of more than 30 days. Confirm whether any separate rental registration or other housing requirements apply.

facts.text: Massachusetts law allows local restrictions and prohibitions on short-term rentals of ADUs.
Newton states that ADUs are prohibited from being used as short-term rentals and must be rented for more than 30 days.

qa.q: Can I list a Newton ADU on Airbnb for weekend stays?
